description:
Silent wrong answer. def isint(_v :: integer), do: true; def isint(_), do: false. Called directly, isint("x") is false. Used in a guard (defp cell(v) when isint(v), do: "int"), cell("x") and cell(:a) return "int". The typed-head discrimination is dropped when the helper is reified for guard use (src/compiler2/jobs/dispatch.rs guard helper reification ~:150, :622; guard grammar src/dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs:404-505). Probes j1, j2, j4, i1 in scratch kernel/.

## Root cause (reader 2026-10-17)
Two builders turn clauses into dispatch rows. entry_source_patterns (jobs/dispatch.rs:295-375) records a type precondition per param annotation; guard_dispatch_from_surface (dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs:334) writes preconditions: Vec::new() (:358). Fix: one clause-to-row builder used by both; helper annotation waits collected by it. Blocks fz-sc8.9 (type-test guards are typed-head Kernel helpers).
title: A guard helper's typed head is ignored when the helper is called from a guard
